_comment: ComponentCatalog UI-TEST scene DEFINITION (201F4F51 template-free). A left nav rail of bookmarks beside a RIGHT scroll TRAY: every component in its own card box, all present, flowing in a scrollable `list`; a bookmark scrolls the tray to that card (card_i.y - card_0.y), the top card's bookmark highlights. The standalone `tabs` control is RETIRED here — superseded by the PTT (paged_menu); the Paged Menu card demos the real nested page->tab behavior (Page 1: Tab 1/Tab 2, Page 2: Tab 3/Tab 4) via two page-gated `pill_toggle` tab rails (the PTT lays out the first VISIBLE rail). The Nav Footer card's BACK/NEXT buttons fire the SAME cat_pm_page_prev/next names the page rail steps on and the root's on_page_prev/next intents fire — one signal name, every trigger. 26 cards. Display strings are $tokens; interactive VALUES ride binds the bench seeds + folds; the paged-menu visibility binds are derived in the PAIR SCRIPT (componentcatalog.lua) from the page/tab. The bench owns + loads this file.
